dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: All of my life savings are gone...

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Are you here to draw amusement from my pitiful life...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whatever happened?

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Listen to me. How could such a thing happen...

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: I was robbed of all I had!

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Ugh, curse those thieves!

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Ah, now I feel like I'm cursing at myself... Eh, wait. This doesn't have anything to do with me, does it? Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Anyway, in the name of Electro Archon and heaven, I know I was wrong! But these were the wealth that I stole— No, took... Uh, earned from all over!

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Wh—Why are you looking at me like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Ah, just leave! And take your mockery of me with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Steal?

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Huh? Did I say that word? Hahah...

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Uh, what are you doing? Wait, please! Put your sword away. I—I will tell you everything I know!

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: I'll be honest. I was indeed a thief once. But just when I was about to quit my job, all of my savings were stolen!

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: This is probably what I deserve... But if someone could help me retrieve my money, I'll be a good person and atone for the rest of my life.

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Ah, should I ask Bantan Sango Detective Agency for help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A thief visiting a detective agency...?

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Maybe they'll help me.

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Anyway, the people from Bantan Sango Detective Agency are far more competent than those useless pieces of garbage at the Police Station. You can ask them for help if you need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: I've heard that the president of the agency is very talented. She might be able to help me retrieve my wealth, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: But I don't think I have the money to pay for the commission. Ugh...
